# test_timer_system — Scenario Graph Reference

TIMER WIDGET TEST

This scenario tests the countdown timer HUD widget (Phase 5 implementation).

TEST PROCEDURE:
1. Game starts — verify timer widget appears (top-right corner)
2. Widget shows 'Next Event: 00:30' format (mm:ss)
3. Watch timer count down
4. At 5 minutes mark: text/border should turn AMBER
5. At 1 minute mark: text/border should turn RED with pulsing animation
6. At 0 seconds: timer fires and bed_state_1 global becomes 'alert'
7. Widget updates to show next timer (bed_state_2)

EXPECTED BEHAVIOR:
- Timer is always visible (unless no pending timers)
- Countdown is smooth and accurate
- Color changes happen at correct thresholds
- When timer fires, NPC reacts (dialogue)

TEST DURATION: 3-5 minutes

NOTE: This is a visual/timing test only. No gameplay objectives.

## How to Read These Diagrams

| Shape | Colour | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Rounded rectangle | Teal | Room / physical area |
| Rectangle | Red | Lock, barrier, or interactive terminal |
| Diamond | Orange | Inventory item or credential |
| Diamond | Red/Pink | NPC or physical key |
| Diamond | Purple | VM flag (challenge completion token) |
| Rectangle | Blue | VM challenge |
| Ribbon | Amber | NPC conversation / action gate |
| Hexagon | Green | Story aim (objective) |
| Hexagon | Amber | Critical path node |
| Circle | Grey | AND gate (all inputs required) |
| Subroutine rect `[[…]]` | Green | Container (holds items) |
| Rounded rectangle | Amber | NPC in room (Rooms & Contents only) |

Edges: `-->` solid = hard dependency; `-.->` dashed = soft / narrative dependency or optional path.

The `▶` node marks the player's starting room.
